[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.Remote Chests is a SMAPI quality-of-life mod for players who want less time spent running between storage boxes and guessing where items are stored.

Features:
- Open a searchable remote chest list with B.
- Press B again to close the list.
- Chinese interface by default, with English support.
- Visible color swatches for chest colors.
- Custom chest names and quick rename.
- Search by chest name, location, color, item name, category, or count.
- Favorites, recent chests, nearby chests, and item group tabs.
- Auto-name unnamed chests based on their contents.
- Stash similar backpack items into a selected chest, with confirmation by default.
- Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.

The default Balanced access mode keeps remote chest access around farm and home areas such as the farmhouse, greenhouse, cellar, sheds, barns, and coops. It does not create items, add money, automate fishing, automate combat, or skip core gameplay.[/color]

Downloads.Description: Metadata refresh with Nexus update key. No gameplay changes.
